fr_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI, appuyé par M. HAGER-UP, propose la suppression de l'article; M. Hagerup attire l'attention sur le projet des commissions des trois pays du Nord.
en_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI, supported by M. HAGER-UP, proposed that the Article should be deleted. M. Hagerup called attention to the plan drawn up by the commissions of the three Scandinavian countries.
